about: Offline S-02/S-01 replay fixture. Five execution attempts of ONE run (first attempt, resume after a pause, guidance turns, a leader-approval retry) with mid-run edits to rules and memory. The usage numbers are SYNTHETIC, shaped like run_metering usage (inputTokens EXCLUDES cache reads). They exercise bench_stats arithmetic; they are not a provider measurement.
goal: Fix the settings dialog so the Save button stays disabled until a field changes.

sources.rules_prompt_block:
PROJECT RULES (advisory)
- run `make lint` before committing
- never edit files under migrations/
sources.skills_prompt_block:
TEAM SKILLS (reviewed)
## ui-forms@2
Forms keep a dirty flag; buttons read it, never the raw fields.
sources.memory_prompt_block:
PROJECT MEMORY (reviewed, advisory)
- the settings dialog lives in frontend/src/settings/Dialog.tsx (u1, reviewed by u2)

attempts.label: resume after pause; a rule was edited while paused
attempts.guidance: GUIDANCE: keep the existing test ids

edits.rules_prompt_block:
PROJECT RULES (advisory)
- EDITED MID-RUN: also run `make typecheck`

attempts.label: guidance turn; a new memory note was reviewed mid-run
attempts.guidance: GUIDANCE: the button is in Footer.tsx

edits.memory_prompt_block:
PROJECT MEMORY (reviewed, advisory)
- EDITED MID-RUN: Footer.tsx owns the buttons

attempts.label: final guidance turn
attempts.guidance: GUIDANCE: also update the snapshot test

expected.note: Hand-computed from the usage above: pooled = 13200 / (8150 + 13200); per-attempt = cacheRead / (input + cacheRead), rounded to 4 places.
